primary_meaning: Trust, reliance, and relational commitment to God and Jesus Christ, extending beyond mere intellectual agreement to include personal surrender and saving faith.

alternatives.meaning: Intellectual assent or cognitive agreement to doctrinal propositions.
Active allegiance, obedience, and faithfulness to Christ as King.
An objective body of Christian doctrine or tradition to be held and defended.

notes: While primarily understood as relational trust (fiducia), theological traditions debate the exact balance of intellectual understanding (notitia), agreement (assensus), and personal trust, alongside modern biblical scholarship emphases on pistis as allegiance.
